scope: Broaden implementation-readiness research for rooted SAB projection, version admission, explicit 3D comparison, and FreeCAD consumer-route qualification.

method.kind: Primary format/project documentation and pinned peer source review
method.evidenceBoundary: ezdxf's ACIS entity relationships are a pinned implementation profile learned from analyzed BricsCAD exports, not normative ACIS authority. ODA v5.4.1 governs DWG AcDs framing/linkage but explicitly excludes detailed SAB internals. Autodesk DXF references govern documented explicit-geometry fields. FreeCAD docs identify configurable routes, not a guarantee for every build. No external or local runtime result was obtained.

observed: The source describes body/lump/shell/face/loop/coedge/edge/vertex/point relationships, linked chains, and optional transform/wire/surface/curve branches.
Face loops and coedge chains are ordered; coedges can have cyclic partner relationships, including more than two partners for non-manifold cases.
The source states that a vertex endpoint's parent edge need not be the current edge.

The documentation says the profile is based on analyzing BricsCAD output and ignores pre-700 differences; its mesh conversion handles only flat polygonal faces and loses curved faces without a kernel.
doesNotEstablish: a normative ACIS schema or all-version pointer layout
validity/closure of a body or correctness of curved analytic geometry
that the local SAB parser resolves every documented relationship
findings.planUse: Limit the additive rooted projection to exact embedded ACIS 21800 until other version deltas are reviewed. Preserve loops/orientation and multiple lumps/shells, bound cycles, validate only defined owners, do not impose vertex.edge reverse equality, and report unimplemented branches and unreachable nodes structurally.

findings.topic: Embedded ACIS version is distinct from DXF target version
observed: The peer lists 20800, 21800, and 22300 ACIS save profiles; 21800 is its default SAB profile for R2013/R2018 while 22300 is another R2018 profile.
doesNotEstablish: universal producer compatibility for every target/profile pairing
safe interpretation of 20800 or 22300 with the local 21800 parser
findings.planUse: Add explicit negative tests for unreviewed 20800 and 22300 inputs; do not infer the embedded schema from DXF ACADVER.

findings.topic: DWG AcDs and SAB authority boundary
observed: ODA §24 describes segment/data indexes, data records, paged blobs, per-record handles, and SAB payloads for ACIS entities.
ODA explicitly places detailed SAB content outside the specification.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS body graph semantics from the DWG container description
B-rep validity from correct handle-to-record association
findings.planUse: Keep ODA-spec AcDs linkage and local SAB profile projection as separate gates.

findings.topic: Explicit 3D geometry and FreeCAD route identity
observed: Autodesk documents 3DFACE WCS corners and invisible-edge flags; polyface declared counts may be inaccurate and readers should tolerate unusual child ordering.

FreeCAD's documentation repository was archived in April 2026; its Draft DXF page describes configurable C++ and optional legacy Python DXF importers, a route-specific 3DFACE support difference, and no stock ACIS blob reading.
FreeCAD DWG open/import uses an external converter followed by a selected DXF importer.
doesNotEstablish: current behavior of every FreeCAD release/build or selected importer
ACIS B-rep semantics from explicit-face import
lossless DWG-to-DXF conversion for arbitrary object graphs
findings.planUse: At the existing composed consumer checkpoint pin the exact FreeCAD build, converter, importer preference, and operation. Keep explicit face/polyface results separate from ACIS and DWG AcDs evidence.

existingOwnersOnly: existing explicit-geometry and FreeCAD consumer gates
nextActions: Implement the rooted projection only under an exact embedded-version 21800 guard.
Preserve graph ordering, multi-root identity, and supported owner/cycle diagnostics; keep transforms and source-unit scaling unapplied.
Use generated test-local graph data and only the focused graph-preservation test/build plus compatibility compile checks for the slice.
Keep unreviewed ACIS versions, native FreeCAD qualification, semantic-reader routes, and all six external J items non-blocking and non-promoting.
